description: Source code for WebmWriter class implementing WebM media writing functionality, including track management, file handling, and metadata writing.

classes.name: WebmWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing WebM media files, managing tracks, metadata, and file I/O.

methods.name: videoTrack
methods.description: Creates a video track entry from metadata, supporting VP8 and VP9 codecs.

methods.name: audioTrack
methods.description: Creates an audio track entry from metadata, supporting Opus and Vorbis formats.

methods.name: numTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of tracks currently added.

methods.name: estimateCuesSize
methods.description: Estimates the size of cues based on file size limits and bit rate.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a media source as a track (audio or video) to the writer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes writing, writes metadata, and starts recording threads.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops recording and finalizes the file.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been reached.
